setup.title: Who is this for?
setup.subtitle: We will show the trackers that fit you. You can change this any time in Settings.

women.title: Women's health
women.description: Cycle, pregnancy, water, mood and nutrition

setup.privacy: Saved only on this device. It is used only to choose which trackers you see.

myTrackers.title: My trackers
myTrackers.emptyMessage: Turn on trackers in Settings to see them here.

install.title: Install the app
install.description: Add Wellness to your home screen or desktop. It opens like an app and works offline.
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.subtitle: Here is how we handle your health information.
privacy.device: Everything is stored on this device first. The app works fully without an account.
privacy.account: An account is optional. It backs up your data, protected so only you can read it.
privacy.noAds: We never sell your data or use it for advertising. There are no ad trackers in the app.
privacy.control: You can export or permanently delete all your data at any time from Settings.

consent.title: Choose what to track
consent.subtitle: Each kind of health data needs your permission. Turn on only what you want. You can change this later in Settings.

notifications.title: Reminders, only if you want them
notifications.subtitle: Everything is off. Turn on what would help. We only ask your device for permission when you first set a reminder.
notifications.lockScreen: Hidden on the lock screen by default; reminders never mention health details.

water.title: Water intake
water.why: Amounts and times you log, to show your daily progress.

mood.title: Mood and journal
mood.why: Mood check-ins and journal entries, to show your monthly insights.

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.why: Bed and wake times, to show your sleep patterns.

cycle.title: Period and cycle
cycle.why: Period dates, flow and symptoms, to estimate your next cycle.

pregnancy.title: Pregnancy
pregnancy.why: Due date, appointments, kicks and weight, to follow your pregnancy week by week.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.why: Meals and foods you log, to show balanced nutrition summaries.

anonymous_analytics.title: Anonymous usage statistics
anonymous_analytics.why: Counts such as which screens are opened. Never includes health details.

consent.gateMessage: To use this tracker we need your permission to store this information.

scheduled.title: Reminders
scheduled.why: At times you choose, like drinking water or a mood check-in.

smart.title: Smart timing
smart.why: Water reminders spread across your waking hours, which wait after a drink and stop once you reach your goal.

achievement.title: Achievements
achievement.why: A note when you reach a milestone. Sent once per achievement.

requirement.title: Missing information
requirement.why: At most once a week, if a tracker needs something from you.

insight.title: Weekly summary
insight.why: A short summary of your week and gentle trends.

account.title: Account
account.optional: Optional. Back up your data and use it on more than one device.
account.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
account.resetMessage: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
account.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
account.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
account.notConfigured: Accounts are not available in this version.

dataControls.title: Your data
dataControls.deleteMessage: This permanently deletes everything on this device, cancels all reminders and, if you are signed in, deletes your account and all data stored in it. This cannot be undone.
dataControls.deleteExportFirst: You may want to export your data first.
dataControls.deleteFailed: We could not delete your account. Nothing was removed. Check your connection and try again.

notificationText.privateUpdate: You have a new update in Wellness
notificationText.requirementInbox: A quick detail would help this tracker work for you

water.drink: Time for a glass of water

mood.checkIn: A quick mood check-in is ready when you are

cycle.periodSoon: A quick note: your cycle estimate has an update

pregnancy.appointment: You have an appointment coming up

requirement.waterGoal: Add your water goal whenever you're ready
requirement.lastPeriod: Add your last period date whenever you're ready
requirement.dueDate: Add your due date whenever you're ready

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyMessage: Reminders, badges and notices will appear here.

prefs.masterHint: Everything stays off until you turn it on, and you choose each type below.
prefs.willReceive: When you turn this on, your device will ask for permission. You will only get the types you switch on.
prefs.privacyHint: Notifications only say “Time for your check-in”, never details.
prefs.systemHint: Account and security messages. They can't be turned off and appear in the notification center.
prefs.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your device settings.
prefs.webNote: In the web app, reminders and badges appear in the notification center. Device notifications are available in the Android and iOS apps.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.insideQuiet: {{time}} is inside quiet hours, so it won't be sent.
reminders.offNote: Reminders are saved but won't be sent until notifications and reminders are on.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.graceNote: Streaks allow one rest day each week.

welcome.name: Welcome aboard
welcome.description: Set up the app your way.

first_entry.name: First step
first_entry.description: Logged something for the first time.

streak_7.name: A good week
streak_7.description: Logged something on 7 days, with a rest day allowed.

streak_30.name: A month of care
streak_30.description: Logged something on 30 days, with a rest day allowed each week.

hydrated_5.name: Well hydrated
hydrated_5.description: Reached your own water goal on 5 days.

mood_14.name: Know your moods
mood_14.description: Checked in with your mood 14 times.

privacy_pro.name: Privacy pro
privacy_pro.description: Read how your data is protected.

colourful_plate.name: Colourful plate
colourful_plate.description: Had vegetables or fruit on 5 days.

home_cooking.name: Home cooking
home_cooking.description: Enjoyed a home-cooked meal on 5 days.

requirements.estimate: This is an estimate, not medical advice.

errors.future: This date can't be in the future
errors.tooOld: Use a date within the last year
errors.dueRange: Use a date within the next 42 weeks

waterGoal.title: Set your daily water goal
waterGoal.why: Your goal lets the Water tracker show your progress and spread reminders through the day.
waterGoal.label: Daily goal ({{unit}})
waterGoal.guidance: The NHS suggests about 6 to 8 glasses of fluid a day. Needs vary with climate, activity, pregnancy and health, so ask a healthcare professional if you're unsure.
waterGoal.source: Source: NHS, “Water, drinks and your health”.

lastPeriod.title: Add the start of your last period
lastPeriod.why: Cycle estimates start from this date. It stays private, and you can change it at any time.
lastPeriod.label: First day of your last period ({{pattern}})

dueDate.title: Add your due date
dueDate.why: Your due date sets the week-by-week content and your appointment timeline.
dueDate.label: Estimated due date ({{pattern}})
dueDate.guidance: Your doctor or midwife can confirm your due date, usually from an early scan.

water.subtitle: Every drink counts toward your day
water.noGoal: Set a goal to see your progress
water.customError: Enter an amount up to 5 litres
water.chartSummary: Last {{days}} days: {{logged}} days logged, {{average}} on average on those days

smart.title: Smart reminders
smart.description: Spread across your waking hours. They wait an hour after a drink and stop once you reach your goal.
smart.needsPermission: To receive them, turn on notifications and the Smart timing type in notification settings.

checkIn.title: How are you feeling?
checkIn.notePrivate: Private to you. Never used for ads.

insights.title: {{month}}
insights.empty: Your month will fill in as you check in.
insights.patternsNote: These are patterns in what you logged, not causes or a diagnosis.

breathe.title: Breathe

patternHints.box: Breathe in, hold, out and hold for 4 seconds each.
patternHints.relax478: In for 4, hold for 7, out slowly for 8.
patternHints.calm: In for 5 and out for 5, with no holds.

breathe.safety: Breathe gently. If you feel dizzy or unwell, stop and breathe normally.

journal.title: Journal
journal.emptyMessage: Your entries stay private to you.

prompts.goodThing: What is one good thing that happened today?
prompts.grateful: Who or what are you grateful for right now?
prompts.kindness: What kind thing could you do for yourself today?
prompts.energy: What gave you energy today, and what took it away?
prompts.tomorrow: What would make tomorrow a little easier?
prompts.proud: What is something you handled well recently?

support.title: Support is available
support.message: If you are struggling or thinking about harming yourself, you don't have to go through it alone. These free, confidential lines are open 24 hours a day.
support.emergency: If you are in immediate danger, call 112 in India or 911 in the USA.

teleManas.name: Tele-MANAS (India)
teleManas.detail: National mental health helpline, 14416 or 1-800-891-4416, in many Indian languages.

lifeline988.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (USA)
lifeline988.detail: Call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org.

sleep.subtitle: Notice how you rest
sleep.invalid: Check the times: a night can be up to 24 hours.

week.title: Last 7 nights
week.empty: Nights you log will appear here.
week.spread: Your bedtimes varied by about {{minutes}} minutes.

windDown.title: Wind-down reminder
windDown.message: A gentle note before bed, at a time you choose.

appLock.title: App lock
appLock.description: Ask for your fingerprint, face or device PIN when opening the app.
appLock.unavailable: Set up a screen lock on this device first.

cycle.subtitle: Periods, symptoms and estimates
cycle.notContraception: Estimates only. Not a form of contraception.

today.next_one: Next period estimated around {{date}}, in {{count}} day.
today.next_other: Next period estimated around {{date}}, in {{count}} days.
today.late_one: Your period is {{count}} day past the estimate. Cycles often vary; if you're worried, talk to a doctor.
today.late_other: Your period is {{count}} days past the estimate. Cycles often vary; if you're worried, talk to a doctor.
today.basedOnDefault: Based on a typical 28-day cycle until you log more periods.
today.empty: Log the first day of a period to see your estimates.

calendar.estimateNote: Estimated days are shown only for the next cycle. They are estimates, not medical advice.

history.title: Your cycles
history.average_one: Average cycle {{cycle}} days and period {{period}} days, from your last cycle.
history.average_other: Average cycle {{cycle}} days and period {{period}} days, from your last {{count}} cycles.
history.needMore: Averages appear once you've logged two period starts.
history.irregular: Your cycles have ranged from {{shortest}} to {{longest}} days, so estimates are shown as a range.
history.outsideRange: Your cycles are often outside the 21 to 40 days the NHS calls common. That can be normal for you, but it's worth mentioning to a doctor.
history.sources: Estimates follow the NHS (periods, fertility awareness), ACOG and FIGO guidance.

reminder.title: Remind me before my period
reminder.description: Two days before the estimated start. The notification won't mention your period.

pregnancy.subtitle: Week by week, appointments and checklists

week.due_one: Estimated due date {{date}}, {{count}} day to go
week.due_other: Estimated due date {{date}}, {{count}} days to go
week.past: Your estimated due date was {{date}}. Stay in touch with your maternity team.

weeks.intro: General information for each week, from WHO, ACOG and the NHS. Every pregnancy is different.

urgent.title: Get help straight away if you have
urgent.action: Contact your doctor, midwife or maternity unit now. In an emergency, call 112 in India or 911 in the USA.
urgent.source: From NHS and ACOG urgent warning signs.

symptoms.severeHeadache: A severe headache that doesn't go away
symptoms.suddenSwelling: Sudden swelling of the face, hands or feet
symptoms.fewerMovements: The baby moving less than usual

calculator.title: Work out your due date
calculator.lastPeriodLabel: First day of your last period ({{pattern}})
calculator.outOfRange: Use a date within the last 42 weeks
calculator.note: This is an estimate (280 days from the last period). Your doctor or midwife can confirm it, usually with an early scan.

stop.title: Stop pregnancy tracking
stop.description: Hides pregnancy content and turns off its reminders. Your logs stay until you delete them.

ended.title: Pregnancy tracking is off
ended.message: Take all the time you need. Your doctor or midwife can point you to support whenever you want it.
ended.deleteConfirm: This deletes your due date and every pregnancy log on this device. It can't be undone.

appointments.title: What it's for
appointments.remindDescription: The evening before. The notification won't say what it's for.
appointments.needTitle: Add what the appointment is for
appointments.needDate: Enter a date from today onwards as {{pattern}}

kicks.early: Kick counting is usually suggested from {{week}} weeks. You can still use it.
kicks.intro: Start a session and tap each time you feel a movement. Many people count to {{count}}. What matters most is getting to know your baby's usual pattern.
kicks.fewerTitle: If your baby is moving less
kicks.fewer: Contact your maternity unit or doctor straight away. Don't wait until the next day, and don't rely on a home heartbeat monitor.

weight.intro: A private record for you and your doctor. There are no targets here.
weight.label: Today's weight ({{unit}})
weight.rangesIntro: The US Institute of Medicine (2009) gives these typical ranges for the whole of a single pregnancy, by BMI before pregnancy. They are not targets. Your doctor will tell you what's right for you.

items.birthPlan: Birth plan, if you have one
items.carSeat: Baby car seat, if travelling by car

bag.source: Starter list based on the NHS guide to packing for labour. Change it however you like.

partner.title: Partner sharing
partner.partnerIntro: If someone shared pregnancy updates with you, enter their code here. You'll see only what they chose to share, for as long as they share it.
partner.noBackend: Partner sharing needs an account, which isn't available in this version of the app.
partner.needAccount: Partner sharing needs an account on both phones, so updates can reach your partner.
partner.signIn: Sign in or create an account

owner.title: Share with a partner
owner.intro: Invite one person with a code. You choose what they see, and you can stop sharing at any time. Stopping removes their access straight away.
owner.never: Notes, symptoms, weight, baby names and everything from your other trackers.

consent.title: Your consent
consent.body: To share, we keep a copy of the parts you choose in your account, readable only by partners you invite. You can withdraw consent at any time, which ends all sharing and deletes that copy.
consent.agree: I agree to share with a partner I invite

invite.title: Invite your partner
invite.label: Your name, as your partner will see it (optional)
invite.message: Join me on Wellness: open Settings, then Partner sharing, and enter code {{code}} before {{date}}.

links.title: Who can see your updates
links.stopped: Sharing stopped. They can no longer see your updates.

withdraw.title: Stop all sharing
withdraw.body: Ends sharing with everyone, deletes the shared copy and withdraws your consent.

join.title: Enter a code
join.label: Invite code
join.invalid: That code didn't work. Check it, or ask for a new one.

notify.title: Tell me when there's an update
notify.description: The notification only says there's an update in Wellness.
notify.unsupported: Notifications for shared updates arrive in the store version of the app. Updates still appear here.
notify.denied: Allow notifications in your device settings first.

sync.title: Backup and sync
sync.signedOut: Your entries are saved on this device only. Sign in to back them up and use them on other devices.
sync.synced: Everything is backed up. Last synced {{time}}.
sync.pending_one: {{count}} change is saved on this device and will sync shortly.
sync.pending_other: {{count}} changes are saved on this device and will sync shortly.
sync.waiting_one: {{count}} change is saved on this device. It will sync automatically when you're back online.
sync.waiting_other: {{count}} changes are saved on this device. They will sync automatically when you're back online.
sync.consentNote: Only the trackers you have allowed are backed up. If two devices change the same entry, the newer change is kept.
sync.otherAccount: This device holds entries from a different account, so they are not added to this one. Sign in with that account to keep syncing them, or start fresh here.
sync.startFreshConfirm: This removes the other account's tracker entries from this device only. That account keeps its backed-up copy.

nutrition.subtitle: Meals and a balanced plate. No calorie targets.

plate.title: Your plate today

guide.IN: ICMR-NIN's "My Plate for the Day" suggests filling about half your plate with vegetables and fruits, with the rest from cereals and millets, pulses, eggs or meat, and milk or curd, plus a few nuts and seeds.
guide.US: MyPlate suggests making half your plate fruits and vegetables, making half your grains whole grains, and varying your protein foods.

plate.empty: Log a meal to see how your day comes together.

source.IN: Guidance: ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition, Dietary Guidelines for Indians (2024).

totals.title: Nutrients today
totals.none: Nutrient values appear for foods that have them, such as your own foods and scanned packets. Built-in foods count toward your plate.
totals.partial_one: From {{count}} of {{total}} foods; the others have no nutrient values yet.
totals.partial_other: From {{count}} of {{total}} foods; the others have no nutrient values yet.
totals.noTargets: Shown for information only. There are no targets to hit.

showEnergy.title: Show energy (kcal)
showEnergy.description: Off by default. When on, energy is shown as plain information, never as a target.

search.label: Search foods
search.hint: Try roti, dal, idli, oatmeal or a dish name.
search.none: No match. Add it as your own food.

nutrition.nutrientLine: Protein {{protein}} g · Carbohydrate {{carbs}} g · Fat {{fat}} g · Fibre {{fiber}} g
nutrition.groupOnly: Counts toward your balanced plate. Nutrient values for the built-in list are added once a sourced database is loaded.

food.intro: Only the name and food group are needed. Everything else is optional.
food.fromOff: Values from {{source}}. Please check them against the packet.
food.name: Name
food.none: Foods you add or scan appear here.

why.name: So you can find it again when you search.
why.group: Used for your balanced plate view.
why.serving: Describes one serving in your own words, so amounts make sense later.
why.optional: Optional. Helps you compare with a packet label.
why.nutrients: Optional. Copy them from the packet label if you want nutrient totals. Leave blank if you don't know.

errors.name: Please enter a name.
errors.number: Please enter a number, or leave it blank.
errors.range: Please enter a number from 0 to {{max}}, or leave it blank.

scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.intro: Point the camera at the barcode on a packet. We look up the product so you don't have to type the label.
scan.privacy: The camera is only used while you scan, and nothing is recorded. Only the barcode number is sent to Open Food Facts, a free and open food database, to find the product.
scan.denied: Camera access is off for this app. You can turn it on in your device settings, or type the barcode number below.
scan.notFound: This product isn't in Open Food Facts yet. You can add it yourself.
scan.failed: We couldn't reach Open Food Facts. Check your connection, or add the food yourself.
